detailed_descriptions.en: In Split Brain Samsara , you and a friend control the same character. One controls the character’s movements and interactions with the physical world, while the other sees different things and interacts with the spiritual realm. Together, you must try to escape a massive station, understand what happened to you, and choose your fate. Every part of the station to figure out what happened: where are the people who used to live here? What were you doing here? Why are there two of you in one body? Puzzles and riddles by analyzing the clues seen by each player, an effective communication will be the key to success. A spiritual world, between reality and the unconscious, where fragments of memories might resurface. A unique cooperative adventure—sharing the same body! New mechanics that lead to even more surprising situations 100% hand-crafted environments and levels Two worlds to explore, each filled with mysteries and challenges The game must be played online and requires both players to communicate to each other.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
In Split Brain Samsara, you and a friend control the same character. One controls the character’s movements and interactions with the physical world, while the other sees different things and interacts with the spiritual realm.

Together, you must try to escape a massive station, understand what happened to you, and choose your fate.

Every part of the station to figure out what happened: where are the people who used to live here? What were you doing here? Why are there two of you in one body?

Puzzles and riddles by analyzing the clues seen by each player, an effective communication will be the key to success.

A spiritual world, between reality and the unconscious, where fragments of memories might resurface.

  • A unique cooperative adventure—sharing the same body!

  • New mechanics that lead to even more surprising situations

  • 100% hand-crafted environments and levels

  • Two worlds to explore, each filled with mysteries and challenges

The game must be played online and requires both players to communicate to each other.
